name: Groove Quantum
description: Groove Quantum builds scalable quantum processors based on germanium spin qubits, using fabrication processes compatible with standard semiconductor manufacturing. The company was spun out of QuTech (TU Delft / TNO) and received a €10M EIC Accelerator grant and equity investment in 2025.

news.title: Groove Quantum Secures €10 Million to Scale Germanium-Based Quantum Chips
news.excerpt: Groove Quantum secured €10 million in EIC Accelerator funding to scale its germanium-based quantum chip technology. The Delft startup was one of 40 companies selected from over 1,000 applicants to receive a mix of grant and equity support.

news.title: Groove Quantum Secures €10M EIC Accelerator Funding for Germanium-Based Quantum Computing
news.excerpt: Groove Quantum, a Delft-based company developing germanium-based quantum computing technology, has secured €10 million through the European Innovation Council Accelerator programme, including a €2.5 million grant. The company was selected as one of 40 deep-tech startups from over 1,000 applicants across Europe.
